scenarios.name: first_run_profile_has_no_login_name_authority
prove: first-run Local User Profile persists server-default display_name='Local Administrator'
no username/login-name field exists in profile persistence or setup/login DTOs
authentication remains exclusively LLD-12 password authority

scenarios.name: display_name_edit_is_descriptive_only
prove: fresh base revision changes only display_name plus Local User Profile metadata revision
local_user_profile_id/actor identity, password verifier, sessions, auto-login, security revision and encryption material remain unchanged
stale revision or idempotency conflict fails closed

expected: Profile metadata remains descriptive and password-only login authority cannot be reintroduced through a username-like field.
